architecture: In-platform adapters using HTTPS APIs/events; no shared database and no fourth integration application.

service_security.authentication: Per-direction service bearer credential with narrow contract scopes
service_security.message_integrity: HMAC-SHA256 over canonical method + path + message_id + sent_at + payload SHA-256
service_security.replay_protection: Reject reused message_id/nonce outside idempotent duplicate path; validate clock skew; rotate secrets through deployment secret store
prohibited: Secrets in payloads or application data tables

http_status.200: Duplicate safely recognised; original receipt returned
http_status.409: Identity/version/checksum conflict; quarantine and operator review

retry.policy: Bounded exponential retry after originating transaction commits
retry.after_final_attempt: Move to dead-letter state with full payload/checksum/error/attempt history; operator may requeue without changing message or idempotency identity
retry.ordering: Preserve aggregate order by entity where material; receivers must also tolerate duplicate and late events

SCOREMAX_UNAVAILABLE: Growth continues prospecting/CRM but creates no product/payment facts
GROWTH_ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE: No learner transaction waits for Growth

large_payloads.content_releases: Use immutable manifest + authenticated pull for 300/1,500 packages; validate manifest and archive checksums before staging.
large_payloads.small_test_payloads: Inline payloads allowed for contract/fixture tests only.
